topic.title: SpectralHybridEncoder (Div/Mul Chains + Metadata Tails): Public LB 0.057 → 0.089
topic.forumName: Enveda CASMI 2026 - Molecule ID From Mass Spectra
topic.content:
Hi everyone!

I wanted to share a lightweight, custom PyTorch architecture I've been experimenting with for MS2 spectral retrieval, along with a fast baseline notebook that runs end-to-end in ~2 minutes on GPU without internet access.

💡 Core Architectural Ideas

Instead of standard additive MLP layers or heavy transformers, SpectralHybridEncoder combines two custom inductive biases tailored to mass spectrometry:

  1. Parallel Division-Multiplication Chains (ParallelDivMulChainLayer): Fragment $m/z$ ratios, neutral losses, and precursor_mz relationships carry strong physical structure. Rather than mixing all features into a single dot product, this layer routes features through 16 isolated parallel paths, each computing a rational interaction: $$y_k = \tanh\left(\tanh\left(\frac{u_{k,1}}{\text{safe}(u_{k,2})}\right) \cdot u_{k,3} + b_k\right)$$ paired with a residual skip-connection from the raw spectral features.

  2. Topological Metadata Tails & Shared "Non-Neuron" (SharedNonNeuron): MS2 spectra vary heavily in peak density (num_peaks from a few peaks to 100+). Every sample carries a dynamic metadata tail tracking exact num_peaks, precursor_mz, and total intensity. A single shared Non-Neuron micro-network reads both layer statistics (mean, max, min) and the log-scaled tail to modulate fragment embeddings based on spectral richness.

📈 Iterative Progress on Public LB

  • v1 (0.057): 16 peaks, 20k training pairs, broad mass window (±0.05 Da), no adduct filtering.
  • v2 (0.089): 32 peaks + pairwise top-fragment mass differences, 120k paired inchikey14 spectra (CLIP-style symmetric contrastive loss), tight mass window (±0.015 Da), exact adduct matching, and multi-spectrum score aggregation per molecule_id.

🔗 Links & Further Exploration

  • Competition Notebook: [https://www.kaggle.com/code/arsenii228/notebook4e97b36fc1?scriptVersionId=369654565]
  • Other Experimental Architectures: If you enjoy exploring unconventional neural blocks (such as game-theoretic reputation layers, local predictive echo neurons, or dynamic metadata tails), feel free to browse the other public notebooks on my profile: [https://www.kaggle.com/arsenii228]

❓ Questions for the Community

  • Since pure library retrieval from train.parquet hits a natural ceiling on unseen de novo test structures, what is the cleanest way to pair a lightweight spectral encoder like this with a Morgan Fingerprint / Tanimoto predictor or external formula/structure candidate set?
  • Any feedback, critiques, or ideas on improving rational mass-ratio layers for MS2 data are very welcome!
